title: Jesus Invites His Saints
description: Jesus Invites His Saints in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book III, prepared for the Lord's Supper, hymn 2, headed “Communion with Christ, and with saints, 1 Cor. 10. 16 17”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus in-vites his saints To meet a-round his board; Here par-don'd re-bels sit, and hold Com-mu-nion with their Lord.

lines: Here pardon'd rebels sit, and hold
For food he gives his flesh,
He bids us drink his blood,
By union with our living Lord,
We the young children of his love,
One body hath its several limbs,
Let all our powers be join'd
Pleasure and love fill every mind,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
